_provenance: Hand-authored index of the three directions in Chapter 6 Research Agenda; related_propositions resolves only to active P1–P4 records. The three source headings and joins are checked against the chapter.
_intent: Index the compact research directions without creating a second research program or reproducing proposition text.

kinds.label: Frontier
kinds.gloss: A moving line the book names and hands to a later program.

kinds.label: Measurement
kinds.gloss: An operationalization of governance into measurable quantities.

kinds.label: Dynamics
kinds.gloss: A learning / organizational feedback the book models but does not test at population scale.

kinds.label: Generalization
kinds.gloss: Whether the theory holds beyond the software case it was built on.

statuses.gloss: Named and operationalized in the book; the open part is extension, not existence.
Argued as a direction with a stated question; not yet answered.
Stated explicitly as a conjecture the book does not prove (dashed in the figure).

agenda.title: Representation Engineering
agenda.one_line: Select, recover or invent useful representations and test their leverage, correspondence and enforcement potential.

agenda.title: Governance and Engineering Capital
agenda.one_line: Track inherited capability, conversion, propagation, maintenance and retirement under credible comparisons.

agenda.title: Capacity and Environment
agenda.one_line: Compare capability and environment jointly, including review under fixed human attention and misleading evidence.
